title: Extraction de l'ADN de Peuplier Noir
author: BTS BioALC

steps.title: Prepare plant material
steps.instruction: In a 1.5 mL tube, place plant material (leaf pieces or buds) occupying ~1/4–1/3 of the tube volume and press the material into the tube; show the tube to the instructor before proceeding.

steps.title: Sterilize cutting tools
steps.instruction: Clean scalpel, scissors, and forceps with ethanol between each sample cut.

steps.title: Add AP1 buffer and RNase
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL AP1 buffer and 4 µL RNase to the tube; vortex vigorously. Do not pre‑mix AP1 buffer and RNase before adding to the sample.

steps.title: Incubate homogenate
steps.instruction: Incubate at 65 °C for 20 minutes, vortexing gently every 5 minutes.

steps.title: Add P3 buffer
steps.instruction: Add 130 µL P3 buffer to the lysate, mix, and incubate on ice for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 5 minutes at 20 000 g (≈13 000 rpm, rotor‑dependent).

steps.title: Transfer supernatant to QIAshredder
steps.instruction: Using a P200 pipette, transfer the supernatant to a QIAshredder Mini Spin column (lilac) placed in a 2 mL collection tube; centrifuge 2 minutes at 20 000 g (or until all liquid passes). Do not disturb the micro‑pellet that may remain at the bottom.

steps.title: Collect filtrate
steps.instruction: Pipette 450 µL of the filtrate into a labeled 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube, avoiding the micro‑pellet; discard the original collection tube with the pellet. If less than 450 µL is recovered, note the actual volume for the next step.

steps.title: Add AW1 buffer
steps.instruction: Add 1.5 × the volume of lysate (e.g., for 450 µL lysate add 675 µL AW1) and mix by pipetting; a slight ethanol‑induced precipitate may appear but does not affect the protocol.

steps.title: Bind DNA to DNeasy column (first load)
steps.instruction: Transfer 650 µL of the mixture to a DNeasy Mini Spin column (white) in a 2 mL tube; centrifuge 1 minute at 6000 g (≈8000 rpm); discard the flow‑through, keeping the column and collection tube.

steps.title: Bind DNA to DNeasy column (second load)
steps.instruction: Repeat the previous step with the remaining mixture until all solution is applied; discard each flow‑through tube after centrifugation.

steps.title: Wash with AW2 (first)
steps.instruction: Place the column in the same collection tube, add 500 µL AW2, centrifuge 1 minute at ≥6000 g (≥8000 rpm); discard filtrate.

steps.title: Wash with AW2 (second)
steps.instruction: Add another 500 µL AW2, centrifuge 2 minutes at 2000 g (13 000 rpm) to dry the membrane; discard filtrate without touching the membrane. Residual ethanol can interfere with downstream steps.

steps.title: Dry column
steps.instruction: Perform a vacuum (empty) centrifugation for 1 minute at 8000 rpm to thoroughly dry the column before elution.

steps.title: Elute DNA (first)
steps.instruction: Transfer the column to a new labeled 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube; add 50 µL AE buffer directly onto the membrane; incubate 5 minutes at room temperature (15–25 °C).

steps.title: Elute DNA (second)
steps.instruction: Repeat the previous step in the same tube to obtain a total elution volume of 100 µL DNA.

steps.title: Store DNA
steps.instruction: Seal the tube and store on a blue cold block (freezer block) pending quality‑control or PCR analysis.
